objective: does candidate identity move the registered H80 outcome above continuation-seed variability at chain1b_lr2@250, tau=160?

locked.selection_rule: standardize summed executed action over the 64-draw pool; seed the greedy set at the draw farthest from the reference; add farthest-point candidates; ties broken by index. Outcome-blind and deterministic.
locked.continuation_keys: 12 per anchor, derived from the manifest root; every candidate AND the reference uses the same 12
locked.statistic: D = matched-seed candidate/reference non-tie rate - same-chunk cross-seed non-tie rate, per component

bootstrap.unit: anchor (repeats and pairs nested, never resampled)

locked.decision: CANDIDATE_EFFECT_IDENTIFIED iff, for the SAME primary continuous component, D_lower > 0 AND ICC_lower > 0
locked.data_use: permanently calibration/noise_floor: no row may enter WM or policy training, calibration of a later model, selector assessment, or behavior evaluation
locked.no_extension: no quota or cap extension; underfill HALTs
